reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: SiC nanoparticles are chemically inert and unlikely to disrupt the order-disorder transition, while dispersion strengthening and crack bridging are well-established toughening mechanisms in brittle intermetallics.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with explicit quantitative falsification criteria (20% toughness increase, 10% caloric deviation), though verifying uniform nanoparticle dispersion and in-situ formation adds practical complexity.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the core trade-off between integrity and caloric performance, proposing a practical, single-intervention solution that would be highly valuable to researchers in this field.
